description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion
Resolve the copy of Multiversal Incursion, creating a token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
